subject: Head-to-head economics and packaging — BrightPath vendor comparison
messages:
From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@brightpath.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: BrightPath AI Procurement <procurement@brightpath.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Head-to-head economics review request

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re starting an internal evaluation to decide whether to replace our incumbent inference provider (CloudServeX) and your notes on predictable latency + observability landed well with the eng team.

Procurement asked me to get a clean head-to-head: total cost of ownership (tokens + infra), packaging options (pilot -> scale -> enterprise), and any onboarding/egress credits you can offer to offset our migration lift. For context, the incumbent is offering:
- 12% discount off list for 12 months
- $75k migration stipend (one-time)
- 60 days of complimentary egress waived

Can Redwood match or come close on an equivalent package? I attached our july billing and usage profile. We’re targeting a procurement decision week of Aug 9 — tight timeline.

Also please call out any runtime compatibility caveats (KV cache, quantized models, or custom tool integrations) that would materially affect go-live effort.

Appreciate a concise side-by-side if possible — a one-pager with recommended packaging + an authorize-to-offer number would be perfect.

Best,
Samantha Ruiz
Head of ML Product
BrightPath AI

Attachments: BrightPath_current_bill.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@brightpath.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Head-to-head economics review request

Samantha —

Thanks for the context and the bill; useful. I pulled together a short head-to-head snapshot (attached) and a pragmatic offer we can present to procurement. High level: we can match the economic posture on run-rate with a different mix of levers — smaller upfront discount + onboarding credits + a staged pilot credit that reduces migration risk. Key proposal options below (numbers are illustrative against your current monthly usage profile):

Option A — Pilot-centric (low initial commitment)
- Pilot credits: $40k applied over first 90 days
- Ongoing discount: 8% off list for 12 months
- Egress: 30 days waived (standard)
- Notes: fastest time-to-validate, some uplift manually for KV cache warm-up

Option B — Scale bundle (recommended for 9–12 month commit)
- One-time migration stipend: $60k
- Discount: 10% off list for 12 months
- Egress credit: 45 days waived
- Bonus: 2 weeks of dedicated onboarding hours with Solutions (up to 40h)

Option C — Enterprise parity (terms for larger commit)
- Migration stipend: $85k (requires 12-month minimum and MRR threshold)
- Discount: 12% off list for 12 months
- Egress waiver: 60 days
- SLA uplift and dedicated success manager

Operational caveats:
- KV cache transfer: we can bulk-warm cache but there’ll be a ~2–4 week warm-up window where tail latency may increase; recommend parallel warm-up using prefix caching to minimize end-user impact.
- Quantized model parity: most open models are compatible; for very custom kernels we’d need a short verification pass (2–3 business days).
- Integrations: function-calling hooks are supported; if you have bespoke toolchains we should add a short scope item in the SOW.

I’ve attached the head-to-head PDF that shows run-rate math and an authorize-to-offer bucket. We can sign off on Option B numbers from sales (subject to finance sign-off on the stipend). If you want faster alignment, I can put Lauren on the thread for negotiation guardrails.

Available for a quick call tomorrow 10–11am PT if that helps.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_headtohead_snapshot.pdf (one-pager)
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@brightpath.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Head-to-head economics review request

Looping in finance context and negotiation guidance.

Rishi — good work on the structure. Quick internal guidance:
- We can authorize up to $60k migration stipend within the standard commercial approval (no extra approvals) if they commit to at least a 9-month seat/consumption fallback.
- Approve the 10% discount in Option B for a 12-month term, but hold the 12%/85k enterprise ask until we confirm ARR thresholds.
- Approve the 40h onboarding solution time as part of the stipend, but insist on measurable go-live milestones (two checkpoints).
- If procurement presses for 60-day egress waive for Option B, counter with a staged egress credit: 30 days guaranteed + additional 30 days if migration completes within the first 60 days.

Marissa — will need a short finance memo to justify the stipend if they push for Option C numbers.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Deal Structuring
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@brightpath.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: BrightPath AI Procurement <procurement@brightpath.ai>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Head-to-head economics review request

Rishi / Lauren —

Thanks — this is helpful and aligns with our internal direction. We’re most interested in Option B but procurement will want a single line item SOW + migration acceptance criteria before we can move the deal to legal. A couple of asks before the Aug 9 procurement decision:

1) Formal SOW with the staged egress credit language you suggested (30 days + conditional 30 days tied to migration completion).
2) A short migration checklist we can attach to the SOW that calls out the KV cache warm-up approach and acceptance KPIs (99th p90 latency target, token error rate targets).
3) Confirmation that the $60k stipend can be applied as both onboarding services and credits to invoices (flexible application).

We’d like to schedule a 30-minute call next Tue (Aug 3) afternoon PT to review the draft SOW with procurement and our infra lead. Can you invite the folks who will own the SOW and technical checklist?

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Samantha
Head of ML Product
BrightPath AI
